service.description: Maintenance's record-lookup provider (Maintenance.xml shell-providers, maintenance.records; design §1.4): work orders, equipment and facilities in Comms' record cards. info and card: a record Maintenance admits the user to (Maintenance.js recordOf: Mantle's scope, a technician their assigned work), its name, organization and a work order's status, opening its Maintenance screen (one it does not admit is left to the other providers); search: the palette's scoped finds for text, as optionList of {value: entity|id, label}; links: the Maintenance links a message's body names, up to five. No cost.

Maintenance's call-context provider (Maintenance.xml shell-providers, maintenance.work; design §1.4): for the number ringing, a colleague's own open work (an employee or agent of an internal organization: the work orders they reported or are assigned, the user's call of Nov 12), else the caller organization's open work orders (its own, when it is one of the internal organizations, and those on equipment it owns, for a customer or vendor), and the equipment under repair among them (the asset of an open work order in progress), as far as the user's Maintenance scope reads them (Mantle's find#MaintenanceWorkOrders and get#MaintenanceWorkOrder as the user), each with its Maintenance link; at most 20. Comms' own provider answers the contacts. No cost and no rate.
